title: Hypochondria
summary: HYPOCHON'DRIA, n. plu. [Gr. a cartilage.] 1. In anatomy, the sides of the belly under the cartilages of the spurious ribs; the spaces on each side of the epigastric region.2. Hypochondriac complaints.
